claim_text: Gillette Stadium owner Robert Kraft, who musician Macklemore said orchestrated his removal as an opening act on Ed Sheeran's tour, once faced a solicitation charge, and his name appears in the files related to late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.
query: Kraft who musician Macklemore orchestrated his removal as an opening act on
summary: But rarely – if ever – has an artist been yanked from a tour for espousing beliefs opposed by a venue owner, as happened to Macklemore when it was disclosed that Robert Kraft, Jewish billionaire owner of The New England Patriots and the team’s Gillette Stadium, was involved in orchestrating Macklemore’s removal from Ed Sheeran’s Loop Tour after he made pro-Palestine comments at two concerts. While he has shown support for humanitarian efforts in Ukraine, signed a letter urging Congress to pass the Equality Act and participated in the Love Music Hate Racism campaign, he is not a Springsteen, U2, Ted Nugent or, deep breath, Ye – musicians who embrace political discourse as part of their identity.
